body:
### Problem

`src/gen/keyset.lua` is `require`d by two code generators, but it is not listed in any
`add_custom_command(... DEPENDS ...)` in `src/nvim/CMakeLists.txt`. When *only* `keyset.lua`
changes, Ninja treats the generated keyset outputs as up-to-date and never re-runs codegen.
The stale generated code then disagrees with the hand-written headers and compilation fails.

This became user-visible with a4773f1980 (*fix(lint): fix some warnings in clang-tidy 22*),
which changed both sides of the same contract:

- `src/nvim/api/private/defs.h:162` — `typedef const KeySetLink *(*FieldHashfn)(const char *str, size_t len);`
- `src/gen/keyset.lua:48` — now emits `const KeySetLink *<name>_get_field(...)`

Only `keyset.lua` changed on the generator side, so an existing build tree keeps the old
non-`const` output:

    build/include/api/private/dispatch_wrappers.h.generated.h:77:
      DLLEXPORT KeySetLink *KeyDict_exec_opts_get_field(const char *str, size_t len);

With GCC 14+ (`-Wincompatible-pointer-types` is an error by default since GCC 14) this fails:

    src/nvim/auto/api/private/dispatch_wrappers.generated.h:10655:38: error: passing argument 2 of
      'api_dict_to_keydict' from incompatible pointer type [-Wincompatible-pointer-types]
    10655 |     if (!api_dict_to_keydict(&arg_2, KeyDict_exec_opts_get_field, args.items[1].data.dict, error)) {
    include/api/private/helpers.h.generated.h:51:62: note: expected 'FieldHashfn'
      {aka 'const KeySetLink * (*)(const char *, long unsigned int)'}
      but argument is of type 'KeySetLink * (*)(const char *, size_t)'

It repeats for every `KeyDict_*_get_field` (`nvim_exec2`, `nvim_open_win`, `nvim_win_set_config`,
`nvim_win_text_height`, `nvim_win_resize`, and `KeyDict_xdl_diff_get_field` at
`src/nvim/lua/xdiff.c:199`), then `ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.`

Missing dependencies:

- `src/gen/gen_api_dispatch.lua:7` — `local keyset = require('gen.keyset')`,
  but the rule at `src/nvim/CMakeLists.txt:603-622` only depends on
  `${API_DISPATCH_GENERATOR} ${GENERATOR_C_GRAMMAR} ${GENERATOR_HASHY}`.
- `src/gen/gen_options.lua:663` — `local keyset = require('gen.keyset')`,
  but the rule at `src/nvim/CMakeLists.txt:713-716` only depends on
  `${LUA_GEN_DEPS} ${OPTIONS_GENERATOR} ${GENERATOR_HASHY}`.

Two notes on why this went unnoticed:

- CI configures a fresh build directory every time, so the stale-output path is never hit.
- Clang only warns about the mismatch, so even a stale tree builds there. It is fatal on GCC 14+.

About `make distclean` from the checklist: it does work around this (it deletes `build/`, forcing
full regeneration), but it masks the bug rather than fixing it — the dependency graph is still
wrong, and any future edit to `keyset.lua` alone will silently produce stale generated code again.

Suggested fix:

        --- a/src/nvim/CMakeLists.txt
        +++ b/src/nvim/CMakeLists.txt
        @@ -316,6 +316,7 @@ set(GENERATOR_C_GRAMMAR ${GENERATOR_DIR}/c_grammar.lua)
         set(GENERATOR_HASHY ${GENERATOR_DIR}/hashy.lua)
        +set(GENERATOR_KEYSET ${GENERATOR_DIR}/keyset.lua)
         set(GENERATOR_PRELOAD ${GENERATOR_DIR}/preload_nlua.lua)
        @@ -620,6 +621,7 @@ add_custom_command(
             ${GENERATOR_HASHY}
        +    ${GENERATOR_KEYSET}
             ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/api/dispatch_deprecated.lua
        @@ -715 +717 @@ add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${GENERATED_OPTIONS} ...
        -  DEPENDS ${LUA_GEN_DEPS} ${OPTIONS_GENERATOR} ${GENERATOR_HASHY} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/options.lua
        +  DEPENDS ${LUA_GEN_DEPS} ${OPTIONS_GENERATOR} ${GENERATOR_HASHY} ${GENERATOR_KEYSET} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/options.lua

More generally, depending on the whole `src/gen/*.lua` set (e.g. `file(GLOB ... CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)`)
would stop newly extracted generator modules from silently dropping out of the dependency graph.

### Steps to reproduce

Build-system bug; no minimal.lua needed. Requires GCC >= 14 (with clang the mismatch is only a warning).

    git clone https://github.com/neovim/neovim && cd neovim
    git checkout a4773f1980~1                 # last commit before the `const KeySetLink *` change
    make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release             # populates build/ with pre-const generated keysets
    git checkout master                       # ac1a06021d
    make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$HOME/.local/nvim install

The second `make` reuses the stale `build/` outputs and fails. Ninja only schedules ~52 edges and
never re-runs the keyset codegen — `build/src/nvim/auto/api/private/dispatch_wrappers.generated.h`
keeps its old mtime while `src/gen/keyset.lua` is newer.

Confirming the diagnosis — force codegen to re-run and the same command succeeds:

    touch src/gen/gen_api_dispatch.lua src/gen/gen_options.lua
    make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$HOME/.local/nvim install

After that, `build/src/nvim/auto/api/private/dispatch_wrappers.generated.h:1513` correctly reads
`const KeySetLink *KeyDict_exec_opts_get_field(const char *str, size_t len)` and the build + install
complete (exit 0).

### Expected behavior

Modifying `src/gen/keyset.lua` should re-trigger every codegen step that `require`s it
(`gen_api_dispatch.lua`, `gen_options.lua`), so an incremental build stays consistent with the
hand-written headers. An up-to-date `master` checkout should build with GCC 14 without needing
`make distclean` or a manual `touch`.


### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1708+gac1a06021d     Build type: Release     LuaJIT 2.1.1788460057

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A — this is a CMake/Ninja codegen dependency bug in Neovim's build system, not editor behaviour

### Operating system/version

Linux Server 7.2 (Paladin), kernel 4.19.91-013.ali4000.alios7.x86_64

### Terminal name/version

tmux (not relevant to this build issue)

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

build from repo
